summary: Add a single new Java source file defining a Vehicle class as a plain data object (the issue says "mojo"; interpreted as POJO) with a sensible initial set of fields. Fields are expected to be revised later.
approach: Create one Vehicle.java containing a simple POJO: private fields, a no-arg constructor, an all-args constructor, getters/setters, and equals/hashCode/toString. The repository currently contains no Java code and no build file (only pipeline tooling in TypeScript under tools/bob-pipeline), so the class is added under a conventional Maven/Gradle-style layout (src/main/java/<package>/Vehicle.java) without introducing a build system. Initial fields use best judgement: id, make, model, year, vin, color, mileage. Keeping the class minimal and dependency-free makes later field changes cheap.

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The issue asks for a mutable-looking "mojo/POJO" and fields are expected to change; a conventional class is more broadly compatible and easier to evolve.
Would add a dependency and a build system that do not exist in the repo.

alternatives_considered.option: Add a full Maven/Gradle project alongside the class
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Out of scope for the request.

alternatives_considered.option: Interpret "mojo" as a Maven plugin Mojo
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: A Maven Mojo is an executable plugin goal and does not fit "a vehicle class"; the vehicle-domain data-object reading is far more plausible.

components: Java source tree (new) - new Vehicle domain class; no existing components modified
assumptions: "Mojo" is a typo/variant of "POJO" (plain old Java object).
No Java code, build file or package convention exists, so the package name (e.g. com.neversoft.vehicle) and src/main/java layout are chosen by us.
Target Java version is Java 25 (per author feedback).
Field list is provisional and will be revised in a follow-up.
No tests are required for a plain data class in this issue.

risks.risk: "Mojo" actually means a Maven plugin Mojo
risks.mitigation: Record the interpretation in the PR description and confirm with the issue author.

risks.risk: Chosen package name/location conflicts with later project structure
risks.mitigation: Use a conventional layout; moving a single file is trivial.

risks.risk: Field set does not match the author's needs
risks.mitigation: Explicitly provisional per the issue; keep class simple to change.

risks.risk: No build tooling to verify compilation in CI

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new file Vehicle.java exists under src/main/java/ in a package declared consistently with its directory path.
Vehicle is a public class with private fields for id, make, model, year, vin, color and mileage, using appropriate types.
Vehicle provides a no-arg constructor, an all-fields constructor, and getters and setters for every field.
Vehicle overrides equals, hashCode and toString consistently over its fields.
The file compiles with a standard JDK (javac) with no external dependencies and no warnings.
No existing files in the repository are modified.
